newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: South African shares ended firmer in quiet trade on Friday, with industrials stronger and golds also rising slightly, dealers said.
Dealers said the market was gearing itself up for the unit trust close-out on Tuesday.
Relatively large volumes were traded in De Beers, Powertech and Plateglass. Futures players were largely absent as the futures market closed early at 1000 GMT, they said.
Golds were quiet in thin volumes on a steady bullion price.
The overall index rose 21 points to 6,583.1 points, the industrial index gained 31.7 points to 7,815.2 and golds finished up 6.2 points to 1,495.3 points.
